Part I — The Proposal

01Close the trust gap with software

The situation

ANAX Developments is four projects old, with its first handover arriving in 2026 — competing for buyers whose last purchase came with Emaar One or DAMAC Living installed on their phone. Today there is no ANAX buyer app on either store. Yet every ANAX buyer is asked to wire AED 1.2M+ against renderings and wait years for keys. Legacy developers sell on decades of delivered towers; a rising developer must sell the same feeling another way: certainty, delivered as product.

What I'd build

The ANAX Investor Companion — and not a copy of Emaar One, which is a payments-and-maintenance portal. A leapfrog: a weekly build-story feed that lets an owner in London or Dallas watch her floor being poured; milestone-linked payments with escrow letters and title documents in a vault; an investor lens (rental yield, resale tracking); a one-tap referral engine — because a delighted off-plan buyer is the cheapest sales force in Dubai; and a multilingual AI concierge grounded strictly in project documents. I have shipped exactly this class of software: banking features for Citi used by millions at 99.4% crash-free, a health-insurance member app, streaming features for a Fortune-500 consumer brand.

02Open the buyer channel nobody owns: America's South Asian diaspora

The situation

Dubai developers work UK, Indian, and CIS buyers intensively. Meanwhile the wealthiest South Asian diaspora in the world — doctors, engineers, and business owners in Dallas–Fort Worth, Houston, New Jersey, and the Bay Area — is barely touched, because almost no one credibly stands in both worlds.

What I'd build

The ANAX US Investor Bridge. I am a licensed Texas agent (TREC #830185-SA) living inside the DFW diaspora community; a property investor who underwrites her own deals — currently mid-renovation on a value-add project I financed, modeled, and manage myself; and a verified creator with 13,000+ engaged followers. I would run monthly "Investing in Dubai from the USA" webinars and quarterly roadshows, publish honest build-in-public content on ANAX projects, and hand your sales team a warm, qualified pipeline — measured in AED reservations, not impressions.

What ANAX gets
  • A new international sales channel with a trusted local face — testimony, not brokerage
  • Marketing that compounds: an American engineer-investor doing her own diligence on ANAX, in public
  • A repeatable webinar-to-reservation funnel with clean attribution

03Make the sales operation AI-native

Off-plan leads are won in minutes, across languages and time zones — but AI deployed carelessly hallucinates and embarrasses the brand. Evaluating frontier AI models is part of my professional work: I know precisely what these systems can be trusted to do. For ANAX: sub-minute multilingual first response to every lead, AI-assisted qualification and follow-up, and investor-facing ROI tooling — audited, grounded, brand-safe.
